name: Accept reconstructed shapes
description: Converts accepted proposals into ordinary editable shape layers while preserving provenance and associations with extracted HTML text.

fields.name: accepted_proposals
fields.description: Lists reviewed proposals selected for conversion into editor shape layers.

fields.name: preserve_source_masks
fields.description: Keeps original detector masks and automatic fits linked to accepted layers for diagnostics, comparison, and later restoration.

fields.name: associate_html_text
fields.description: Links spatially related HTML text elements to their reconstructed parent shapes without rasterizing the text.

fields.name: create_new_version
fields.description: Creates a recoverable editor version instead of replacing the existing canvas state.

action.name: Create editable shapes
action.description: Creates shape layers from accepted geometry and fill estimates, records provenance, preserves prior proposals, and hands the layers to the basic shape editor.

output.name: editable_shape_layers
output.description: Returns editor layers ready for borders, shadows, gradients, alpha, images, textures, rotation, perspective, SVG paths, semantics, nesting, and grid conversion.
